instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. In an indoor ballet studio with large windows and a wooden barre, the young girl in a blue and white tutu (R1) stands on the left, holding the instructor's hand high and looking up at her. The blonde ballet instructor in a black leotard and skirt (R2) stands on the right on pointe shoes, holding the girl's hand overhead while extending her left arm and smiling. Bright natural light streams from the background windows, illuminating the dancers.
